# SmartHub

> تطبيق إسلامي شامل: أوقات الصلاة، الأذكار، القرآن الكريم، التقويم الهجري، الطقس، الألعاب والمراسلة في مكان واحد.

SmartHub is a comprehensive Islamic companion web app. It bundles prayer times (Aladhan + astronomical calculation), Hijri/Gregorian dual calendar, Quran virtues and tafsir, prophetic-day routines, timed and untimed sunnah libraries, duas, Arabic poetry diwan, weather (Open-Meteo), Islamic occasions, RSS reader, a knowledge archive, a PKM note layer, a travel atlas, end-to-end messaging, and a collection of games. The interface is Arabic-only (RTL) and ships a light "paper" default theme alongside a dark "Obsidian Depth" theme.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Prayer times, weather, dual calendar, greeting, and quick sections.
- [Duas](/duas): Curated Islamic supplications in Amiri typography.
- [Diwan](/diwan): Classical Arabic poetry organized by era.
- [Occasions](/occasions): Upcoming and past Islamic occasions with countdowns.
- [Reading](/reading): Reading material and saved content.
- [Wellness](/wellness): Nutrition, supplements, skin/hair, and personal insights.
- [Games](/games): Sudoku, chess, memory, minesweeper, color maze, pipes, dice, target, puzzle, hex, focus.
- [Settings](/settings): Theme, fonts, prayer calculation method, profile.

## Sections

- [Timed Sunnah](/section/timed-sunnah): Sunnah practices tied to daily prayer times.
- [Untimed Sunnah](/section/untimed-sunnah): General sunnah practices.
- [Prophetic Day](/section/prophetic-day): The Prophet's daily routine across eight periods.
- [Quran Virtues](/section/quran-virtues): Virtues of reciting and memorizing the Quran.
